title: Bluegrass Breeze | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the charming Camp District of Watercolor, Bluegrass Breeze offers a delightful escape in a beautifully designed four-bedroom residence that radiates warmth and style. Light floods the interiors, highlighting the elegant decor and creating an inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxation and entertainment. Accommodating up to ten guests, this home boasts modern conveniences and luxurious amenities, including a golf cart for exploring the scenic surroundings. The ground floor features an open-concept living area that merges seamlessly with the dining space and a well-equipped kitchen adorned with stainless steel appliances, a chic dining table for eight, and additional bar stool seating for four. The master suite offers a sanctuary of its own with a king-sized bed and an en-suite bathroom complete with a soothing soaking tub and shower. The charm extends to the second floor where comfort meets functionality in two additional guest bedrooms, each thoughtfully appointed with private bathrooms. One bedroom serves as a perfect retreat for adults with a king-sized bed, while the other is designed delightfully for younger guests, featuring two twin-over-twin bunk beds. A cozy seating area with a TV on this level provides a wonderful spot for family movie nights or unwinding after a day spent at the beach or exploring Camp Watercolor. A screened-in porch on the first floor serves as a serene backdrop for enjoying the balmy evenings or morning tranquility, making Bluegrass Breeze not just a place to stay, but a memorable part of your vacation experience.
